note: 21 hook formulas with Russian illustrative examples and RU/EN lexical patterns. All examples are fictional templates, not evidence. Do not attribute their experience or figures to the author. Classification describes wording, not success. Russian scores are not calibrated on channel outcomes.
rules: Match the title promise to the opening.
Choose one principal question or outcome.
Verify numbers, experience and sources; never invent evidence for a formula.
Show promised artifacts early enough for the format.
Adapt the opening to the genre and audience rather than enforcing one structure.

hooks.name: The Statistic
hooks.shape: In a sample with a named source, state a verified number and its implication.
hooks.example: В тестовой выборке 6 из 10 кадров сняты против света. Покажу, как это исправить.
hooks.fails_when: Fails when the promise is unsupported, misleading, or not delivered. Treat this example as illustrative, never as evidence about the author.

hooks.name: Someone Else's Result
hooks.shape: Use a named creator and an observed result; distinguish correlation from cause.
hooks.example: Этот канал заменил длинное вступление демонстрацией. Сравним два выпуска.
hooks.fails_when: Fails when the promise is unsupported, misleading, or not delivered. Treat this example as illustrative, never as evidence about the author.

hooks.name: The Mistake
hooks.shape: Name a recognizable, checkable mistake without accusing the viewer.
hooks.example: Вы настраиваете свет после камеры? Покажу, что из-за этого приходится переделывать.

hooks.example: Советуют начинать с дорогой камеры. Сравним её с телефоном при одинаковом свете.
